title: Nutty Australian Tofu Skewers
description: A pungent and crumbly Australian dish featuring sazon and emulsification, perfect for adventurous plant-based eaters. This recipe combines the flavors of Australia with the versatility of tofu.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sazon seasoning, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, and olive oil to emulsify the sauce.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Thread the tofu cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Sprinkle the chopped macadamia nuts over the tofu cubes.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tofu is golden brown.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional macadamia nuts if desired.
